notes: The first sentence (وروى ... نحو حديث شيبان) is a version remark with its own names: a variant group, never a route of this saying.
The compiler's route (حدثنا بذلك هاشم بن الوليد الهروي) ends at أبو بكر بن عياش; the text writes no further name for that route, so none is added.
The chain's names after Abu Bakr sit in the variant sentence; whether they belong to the compiler's route is a doubt, not settled here.
